description.value:
Frequency once per day

Trigger You would die.

In a final gambit, you fill yourself with umbral energy in a gruesome display of shadowy tentacle that disquiets all but the hardiest foes. You remain conscious and regain @Damage[6d8[healing]] Hit Points. Each enemy creature that can see you must succeed at a @Check[will|against:spell] save against your spell DC or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 2}; this is a fear and visual effect.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance
